definitions.explanation: The money a company pays out to its shareholders from its profits.

examples.japanese: {配当金|はいとうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{配当金|はいとうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The dividend went up this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{配当金|はいとうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many companies pay a dividend every year to shareholders who hold their stock for a long time.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配当金|はいとうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a dividend
- {配当金|はいとうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a dividend is paid
- ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧{配当金|はいとうきん}: shareholder dividend
